tests.title: Question bank – 7.2 Reasons for Differences between Cash Book and Pass Book

questions.question_text: Cheques issued but not yet presented for payment make the pass book balance:
options: Higher than the cash book balance
Equal to the cash book balance
Lower than the cash book balance

questions.question_text: Cheques deposited but not yet collected make the pass book balance:
options: Higher than the cash book balance
Lower than the cash book balance
Equal to the cash book balance

Lower than the pass book before adjustment
